name: American Creek Campground
note: City of Chamberlain campground on the Lake Francis Case (Missouri River) shore at the north edge of downtown, with a boat ramp, fishing pier and swim beach beside the day-use area. Pad lengths are not published; imagery shows travel trailers of roughly 28-35 ft on the pads, and a 2026 camper found one site a little short for a truck and trailer. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site americancreekcampground.com (read 2026-11-22, '2025 Rates'): RV sites $55/night with electric + water (30/50 A), tent sites, cabins, phone reservations 605-234-5151, open May 1 - Oct 20; campsite map numbers RV sites 1-64 in drive-in loops; City of Chamberlain commission minutes 2024-02-20 ('approved the new campground rates as presented for the American Creek Campground') and 2025-02-03 ('approved the camper rate increases for the American Creek Campground') show a city-owned campground (local, no price gate); Esri imagery 2026-11-22 shows RVs/trailers ~28-35 ft parked on the pads; Dyrt reviews dated June-Aug 2026 confirm it operated in 2026 -> real drive-in RV campground.
waterfront_evidence: Operator campsite map (map-2.jpg, aerial base) + Esri imagery read 2026-11-22: west-loop pads (25, 27, 28, 32) sit ~35-40 m from the riprapped Lake Francis Case (Missouri R) shore but behind the campground's own dirt loop road and a paved shoreline path, across open grass with scattered trees -> water visible, not on-water; north spur pads 53-59 back toward the shore ~10-30 m away but under a continuous tree band (canopy illegible, no per-site shoreline source) -> not confirmed; 2026 Dyrt reviewer says sites 32, 33 and 37 overlook the river. No dam issue: pads 421 m vs water ~414 m (Open-Meteo DEM), Fort Randall Dam far downstream. Default down to lakeview.

fees.note: Electric + water site; tent sites $35. 9% tax extra; posted prices are card prices with a 3.5% cash discount built in.

fees_source: https://americancreekcampground.com/ rates section headed '2025 Rates' (read 2026-11-22): 'RV Site $55 / night + taxes and fees, Electric and Water, 30 and 50 Amp'; 'Tent Site $35 / night'; 'Additional 9% tax applies'; 'All prices listed, advertised, and quoted have a 3.5% cash discount incentive built into the pricing'. No 2026/2027 rate posted.

booking.note: Reservations by phone only; reservations not required. Weekend minimum covers Friday and Saturday. One night's site fee is charged on any cancellation; no reservations taken November-March.

booking_source: https://americancreekcampground.com/ (read 2026-11-22): 'Reservations can only be made by calling the office at 605-234-5151'; 'Reservations are not required but are highly recommended'; 'Reservations open 90 days before arrival'; RV site: '2 night minimum on weekends "Friday & Saturday" and 3 night minimum on holidays'; 'No off-season reservations will be taken November - March'; 'A cancellation fee equal to one night's site fee will be charged'.
hookups_source: https://americancreekcampground.com/ (read 2026-11-22): RV Site 'Electric and Water, 30 and 50 Amp ... * Sewer dump station available'; 'Site amenities include: Water, electricity, fire rings, and picnic tables.'
facilities_source: https://americancreekcampground.com/ (read 2026-11-22): 'two shower houses ... dump station and potable water'; campsite map marks two 'Vault Toilet' buildings and 'RV Dump Station'.
season_source: https://americancreekcampground.com/ (read 2026-11-22, page (c) 2025): 'The campground will be open from May 1st - October 20th weather permitting.' 2027 dates not published.
flags: Ownership local rests on the city commission minutes (cityofchamberlain.com/city-meeting-minutes, 2024-02-20 and 2025-02-03 set the campground's rates); it is run by on-site managers and The Dyrt calls it 'privately managed'. USACE's Lake Francis Case page lists 'American Creek Campground Access' as managed by others. If AWH judged it private, $55 is over the US$50 gate with no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py), so it would be a price drop.

Site count omitted: the operator map numbers sites 1-64 with a 'Host' label beside site 1, so the public count is 63 or 64; directories say 64 sites, 35 pull-throughs, 29 full hookups (the operator lists electric + water only, sewer by dump station).
Flush toilets not stated on the operator page (shower houses only), so left out of facilities.

The operator page carries a commented-out 'Temporarily closed due to high water levels' banner (not displayed); 2024 FEMA flood work at American Creek is in the city minutes; Dyrt reviews from June-August 2026 confirm a 2026 season.
Pin moved from the operator's GPS (43.81781,-99.32755, the office/entrance on US-50) to the centre of the camping loops.
For lead 24: a 2025 news item and the city minutes mention other Chamberlain campgrounds (River City Campground, Hilltop Campground, and a denied 177-lot proposal); not vetted.
